newsitem.title: USA: Piedmont Mining sells shares, issues notes.
newsitem.headline: Piedmont Mining sells shares, issues notes.

text.p: Piedmont Mining Co Inc said it issued and sold 1,525,000 shares of its common stock at $0.40 per share in a private placement, as well as $240,000 of convertible notes.

The company said it sold the private placement to investors, which it declined to identify. It sold the notes -- which mature June 30 and are convertible into common stock at $0.40 a share after March 31 -- to some of its board members.
The company said it used a portion of the convertible notes issuance to pay off in full the $1.37 million August 1996 arbitration award against it in favor of Amex Gold Inc.
